exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Solana (SOL) traded at $89.9600 as of 2026-11-07 09:50:41 UTC, +0.13% over one hour and -0.08% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $89.5900 to $91.3300; spot sits at 21% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -5.53% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($90.1791) is below the 72-hour average ($92.1761). Spot is 7.05% below the seven-day high of $96.7814 and 1.13% above the seven-day low of $88.9589.

exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 2.84% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 46.0, conventionally neutral.

exhibits.statement: Twenty-four-hour trading volume was $1.81 billion, equal to 3.41% of the $53.17 billion market capitalization.

exhibits.title: Market Sentiment
exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 25 ("Extreme Fear"), versus 30 7 days earlier.

exhibits.title: Chainlink Price Feed
exhibits.statement: The Chainlink SOL/USD Data Feed on Ethereum mainnet last reported $91.0100, 19.2 hours before the spot quote and +1.17% against the spot price in Exhibit A. Practice positions are entered and settled at this mark.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. The market is undervalued: Spot SOL trades at $89.96 while the authoritative Chainlink feed—used for settlement—posted $91.01 only 19.2 hours earlier, a 1.17% premium to the current price, indicating a pricing gap ripe for capture [Ex. A, G].  

2. Liquidity is ample and fear is high: A $1.81 billion 24‑hour volume (3.41% of market cap) ensures deep order books, while the Fear & Greed Index sits at 25, “Extreme Fear,” a classic contrarian bullish signal [Ex. E, F].  

3. Momentum is poised to reverse: Seven‑day trend is down 5.53% and the 24‑hour average sits below the 72‑hour average, yet volatility is modest at 2.84% per day, suggesting the price can rebound without extreme risk, and the RSI at 46 is edging toward bullish territory [Ex. C, D].  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.  

1. The market is demonstrably undervalued: Spot SOL trades at $89.96, yet the authoritative Chainlink feed posts $91.01, a 1.17% premium, indicating a price dislocation that a short position can capture [Ex. A, Ex. G].  

2. Momentum is negative and weakening: Seven‑day price is down 5.53% with the 24‑hour average below the 72‑hour average, and the RSI at 46 signals waning buying pressure, presaging further decline [Ex. C, Ex. D].  

3. Fear dominates sentiment while liquidity remains ample: The Fear & Greed Index at 25 reflects extreme fear, a classic contrarian short catalyst, and $1.81 B of daily volume assures execution without slippage [Ex. F, Ex. E].  

The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s first point rests on a fleeting feed discrepancy; the Chainlink price is 19.2 hours stale and cannot outweigh the live spot at $89.96, a marginal 1.17 % gap that market makers will arbitrage away instantly [Ex. A, Ex. G]. Second, the Bear’s momentum claim ignores the neutral RSI of 46, which does not signal bearish pressure but merely equilibrium, and the 24‑hour range shows price sitting at only 21 % of the interval, indicating limited downside room rather than a slide [Ex. B, Ex. D]. Thus the evidence does not support a short bias. Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull’s “undervalued” claim collapses when we consider that the Chainlink feed is stale by 19.2 hours; price gaps of this magnitude routinely close as arbitrage eliminates them, so the feed offers no forward‑looking premium [Ex. G, A]. Moreover, the “fear‑driven bullish” narrative ignores the seven‑day downside and the fact that today’s spot sits 21 % into its 24‑hour range, indicating the price is already near the lower bound of recent trading activity and has limited upside room [Ex. B, C]. Hence the Bull’s bullish premises are both temporally and technically unsound. Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds a modest bullish bias for SOL/USD over the next 24 hours.

findings.finding: Spot price is $89.96, modestly below the recent Chainlink feed of $91.01.
Fear & Greed Index at 25 signals extreme fear, a contrarian bullish cue.
RSI at 46 is neutral, not confirming bearish pressure, and volatility is low (2.84%).
Current price sits at only 21% of the 24‑hour range, limiting immediate downside.

ruling.opinion: The Chainlink feed premium suggests upward pressure, while extreme fear offers a contrarian bullish signal; low volatility and a neutral RSI reduce downside risk, and the price’s position near the lower third of its daily range leaves limited room for further decline. Collectively these factors support a modest long practice position.
ruling.dissent: The Bear argues the stale Chainlink premium will be arbitraged away and the 5.5% seven‑day decline signals continued weakness, outweighing any contrarian bullish cues.
